text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1512, Hinge Pin Door Stop for Heavy Duty Commercial Hinges

The Commercial Hinge Pin Door Stop keeps both walls and hardware safe without putting stress on the door, the door frame, or the wall. The hinge pin stop hits on the hinge leaf. This type of door stop is also great for use on doors where a standard door stop just isn't possible such as where one door opens into another door. It is easy to install, just remove the stock hinge pin from your 4" x 4" or 4.5" x 4.5" heavy duty hinges and replace with the hinge pin door stop. The 1512 Door Stop allows the door to open up to 170 degrees, but you can adjust it to open as wide as you want. Available in brass, chrome, and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also available: Residential Hinge Pin Door Stop

Features and Specifications of the Don-Jo 1512 Commercial Hinge Pin Stop:

  • Material: Steel
  • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
  • Hinge Pin Length: 4-1/16"
  • Hinge Pin Diameter: 5/16" (.315)
  • Opens to 170 Degrees.
  • Hinge pin stop hits the hinge not the door or the frame.
  • Easy to install.

Sold Individually
